text:
Maya: tiny idea — lunchtime activity: 'squeaky chair Olympics'. who’s in? one squeak = one point :laughing:
Owen: 100% in. will bring my vintage squeaker.
Priya: rules? prize? (also is this a sanctioned sport)
Maya: winner gets 10 snack credits + glory. rules: no damaging chairs, 60s rounds, scoring by loudness and creativity.
Luca: can we get a judge panel? I nominate Ben for impartiality and living next to a drum kit.
Ben: I accept impartiality duties but will be biased toward rhythm.
Samira: can we livestream to the #random-for-parents channel? would love to subject my dog to my shame. :dog_face:
Owen: GIF: https://giphy.com/squeak-sprint (just imagine)
Priya: note: please avoid squeaking in meeting rooms. past tense is trauma.
OpsBot: Reminder: please keep noise under 85dB near the lab. See policies at https://intranet/health-safety.
Maya: updated: if song accompaniment used, +2 creativity bonus. 
Luca: one-liner entry: "I came. I saw. I squeaked."
Ben: entry: "Chair whisperer — now accepting applause."
Samira: tiny poll — snack after? yes/no/maybe. :popcorn:
Owen: yes — and also a tiny haiku: "seat sings under me / office harmony in creaks / lunchtime applause roars"
Priya: I’ll volunteer to time rounds. who wants to keep score on a spreadsheet? (I will accept ceremonial clipboard instead)
Maya: scoreboard = whiteboard by kitchen. 12:30 start. see you there! :trophy:
Samira: bringing confetti (biodegradable). :confetti_ball:
Ben: last note: whoever wins must perform a dramatic victory wobble.
Maya: agreed. mandatory wobble. :eyes:
